newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ICTSI says to issue convertible note.
newsitem.headline: ICTSI says to issue convertible note.

text.p: International Container Terminal Services (ICTSI) said on Friday it plans to issue U.S. dollar-denominated convertible notes upto a maximum of $130 million.
In documents supplied to the Philippine Stock Exchange, the port operator said a maximum of $66 million would be offered to new investors and proceeds used to finance projects of ICTSI.
It said the balance would be reserved for holders of ICTSI convertible notes issued in 1994 and would be given in exchange of the old notes.
It said the notes would mature in seven to 10 years but said other terms were still being finalised.
